# Ryan Morais

**English** · [Português (Brasil)](README.md)

**Software developer and technology educator.**
I teach programming, AI and cybersecurity to people who want to move past theory and build real things.

Here on GitHub I publish the code behind what I teach: open source tools, hands-on labs and step-by-step documented projects. The idea is simple: turn theory into something you can run and adapt.

### 🎯 What I do

- **I build** web applications end to end, from the database to the interface, plus websites, APIs and CLI tools. Code that is tested, typed and shipped by an automated pipeline.
- **I protect** what I build. I analyze vulnerabilities and follow recognized security practices, because security is not a separate topic.
- **I automate** with AI. I use language models and agents to take repetitive work off the table and speed up development.
- **I teach** on the blog, in videos, on the podcast and in the weekly newsletter, explaining the why, not just the command.

### 📌 Featured repositories

| Repository | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [aprenda-com-ryan-morais](https://github.com/ryanvmorais/aprenda-com-ryan-morais) | Index of every project and lab used in the channel's lessons, including the Python exercises for beginners (calculator, tic-tac-toe, snake game and rock-paper-scissors). |
| [webvigil](https://github.com/ryanvmorais/webvigil) | Web vulnerability scanner (DAST) in Python. Reusable engine, CLI and optional dashboard, safe by default to run in production. Open source (Apache-2.0), published on PyPI and as an image on GHCR. Use only on systems you are authorized to test. |
| [mailvigil](https://github.com/ryanvmorais/mailvigil) | DMARC report analyzer in Python, offline and dependency-free. Reads the aggregate reports (RUA) and tells you, in plain language, who sends email on behalf of your domain and whether it is already safe to raise the policy to `p=reject`. Open source (Apache-2.0), published on PyPI. |
| [django-blog-culinario](https://github.com/ryanvmorais/django-blog-culinario) | Multi-page cooking blog in Django. Educational project covering modeling, views, templates, authentication, admin and security. |
